image_prompt: Mrs. Darling, a graceful and ethereal woman in her early thirties, rendered in soft romantic realism with Victorian illustration sensibility. She possesses delicate, refined features with a sweetly knowing expression and faintly mocking mouth that suggests both tenderness and gentle irony. Her dark hair is elegantly arranged in Edwardian-style waves, softly framing her composed face. She wears an exquisite white evening gown of flowing silk with subtle ethereal luminescence, adorned with an ornate borrowed bracelet catching warm lamplight. Her posture is naturally graceful, almost as though mid-pirouette, conveying both maternal devotion and romantic whimsy. Her eyes hold an enigmatic, mysterious quality—like nested Russian boxes—suggesting hidden depths and layers of complexity. Her expression carries subtle traces of tender melancholy and gentle doubt, with a placid beauty that speaks to both nurturing strength and bittersweet poignancy. The soft, dreamy atmospheric lighting casts a warm glow across her features, creating gentle shadows that enhance her ethereal, almost magical presence. Every detail reflects upper-class Edwardian grace intertwined with fairy-tale enchantment.
